correctness.rationale: A direct state-by-state proof shows the terminal vacancy count is 0 or 2, derives an exact two-parameter rational recurrence, proves r_t(k) monotonic in intact-pair count and bounds its product, and bounds joint tagged-pair survival through an algebraically verified q_t(k) inequality. Fixed-T and then T→∞ yield the sharp 3/4 coefficient. Independent exhaustive labeled versus reduced recurrences agree for m=2..7, and 2985 finite exact rational assertions passed; finite checks are not used as the asymptotic proof.

value.rationale: Deletion of a perfect matching is the maximally symmetric degree-one forbidden-edge perturbation of complete-graph deposition. It creates a rare, structurally forced jam with an unexpected sharp coefficient 3/4 rather than the naïve 1/2 of uniformly choosing the last two vertices. This gives a natural, reproducible finite-size kinetic benchmark rather than a relabeled or arbitrary invariant.
